title: Composable runbook snippets library and gated execution harness
creator: Lena Chen
description: Problem: Oncall and Support engineers repeatedly reimplement small remediation steps (drains, cache invalidation, restart sequences, datasource toggles) and the current runbook corpus is brittle: free-form, hard to test, and lacks RBACed, auditable execution. Goal: provide a library of composable, typed runbook snippets (inputs/outputs + idempotency metadata) plus a gated execution harness that supports dry-run simulation, approval gates, and single-click rollback. This ticket covers the core runtime, the snippet registry API, and console telemetry hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Snippet registry API that stores versioned snippets with typed schema and idempotency flags
Execution harness that can run snippets in dry-run mode (no side effects) and then in gated live mode
Audit events emitted for each snippet run (start/finish/result) visible in Console trace view
RBAC policy integration: only allowed roles can execute production-facing snippets; approval flow for elevated snippets
Rollback helper that can infer inverse steps for supported snippet types or attach manual rollback notes
End-to-end tests covering snippet composition, dry-run, and audit log propagation
